column1: # Table A (D9): obligation definitions, stored ONCE. Wave-0 seed: the five
# contracts wave 0 itself enforces; Waves 1-2 populate the quantity/state/
# option matrices from the censuses. All names placeholder pending naming.

column2: title
column3: meaning

column2: every reachable public name classifies 4-way
column3: counted set: dir(torchlens) non-underscore (module layer) + dir(cls) non-underscore for module-level classes (class layer); classes = declared|submodule|deprecated|undeclared; undeclared requires a dated KNOWN-GAP row

column2: every option/entry parameter is cache-keyed or witnessed-dont-care
column3: counted set: public fields of the six Options groups + tl.trace parameters; covered = cache_config key (alias-mapped) | dont-care with witness slot | dated KNOWN-GAP row; burden-inverted per D14

column2: a call warns deprecation iff the registry says so
column3: behavior root: observed CALLS through invocation templates, never metadata (D6); warning must name the registered replacement and the replacement must resolve (D21)

column2: the public-surface denominator is multi-root anchored
column3: counted set: len(__all__); roots: static AST parse, runtime length, PUBLIC_SURFACE_SIZE constant, TARGET_ALL ledger length, classification-baseline declared count; the reachable denominator publishes beside it with its counted set (D8)

column2: published numerals are censused with a dated legacy baseline
column3: counted set: NUMERAL_COUNTED_SET in tests/oracles/_censuses.py; stale baseline rows block; FactRef enforcement for NEW numerals lands Wave 2 (H5)

column2: a module's address depth equals its dotted-address component count
column3: dotted components of the module address below the root; the root address 'self' is 0; unit: levels

column2: the branching factor equals the hand-counted mean fan-out
column3: mean number of children (consumers) per compute Op; unit: children per op (float)

column2: an op's read traffic equals its read-once closed form
column3: theoretical ideal read-once bytes: every input tensor and every parameter of the op read once; unit: bytes

column2: an op's write traffic equals its write-once closed form
column3: theoretical ideal write-once bytes of the op's outputs; unit: bytes

column2: a module's call depth equals its hand-counted nesting depth
column3: nesting depth of the module's call in the call tree, a top-level child at 1; unit: levels

column2: the unaccounted-dispatch count equals the planted gap count
column3: aten dispatch events the completeness witness observed that no captured op accounts for; unit: events

column2: the maximum in-degree equals the hand-counted parent maximum
column3: maximum number of parents over compute Ops; unit: edges

column2: the maximum out-degree equals the hand-counted child maximum
column3: maximum number of children over compute Ops; unit: edges

column2: the backward-pass count equals the number of backward calls issued
column3: backward calls recorded on the trace; unit: passes

column2: the compute-edge count equals the hand count
column3: distinct Op-graph edges whose endpoints are both compute Ops; unit: edges

column2: the module count equals the source model's submodule count
column3: registered source-model submodules; unit: modules

column2: a buffer's overwrite count equals the hand-counted writes
column3: write events recorded for one buffer address; unit: writes

column2: the saved-op count equals the ops the save selection names
column3: Ops whose activation was retained by the capture; unit: ops

column2: retained activation bytes equal the physically retained storage
column3: physical bytes of retained activation payloads (raw and transformed), each storage counted once; unit: bytes

column2: the parameter count equals its closed form on every door
column3: parameter elements in scope: a Trace or summary all declared parameters, a Module its own, a Layer or Op the parameters it consumes, a Param its own elements; unit: elements

column2: the parameter-tensor count equals its closed form on every door
column3: parameter tensors in scope (Trace, Layer, Op, Module, ModuleCall); unit: tensors

column2: the frozen-parameter count equals its closed form on every door
column3: elements of in-scope parameters with requires_grad False; unit: elements

column2: the trainable-parameter count equals its closed form on every door
column3: elements of in-scope parameters with requires_grad True; unit: elements

column2: the executed-parameter count equals its closed form on every door
column3: elements of declared parameters consumed by a captured op; unit: elements

column2: the unexecuted-parameter count equals its closed form on every door
column3: elements of declared parameters no captured op consumed; unit: elements

column2: forward MACs equal their closed form on every door
column3: true forward multiply-accumulates, never flops // 2; non-MAC ops count 0; unit: MACs

column2: forward FLOPs equal their closed form on every door
column3: forward floating-point operations, fma counted as 2 and bias adds counted; unit: FLOPs

column2: the op count equals its closed form on every door
column3: ops in scope; a Layer counts its passes, a module call counts its input and output boundary ops; unit: ops

column2: the pass count equals the number of times the op ran
column3: times a layer's op executed in the forward; unit: passes

column2: the edge count equals the hand-counted graph edges on every door
column3: distinct op-graph edges in scope, boundary edges included; unit: edges

column2: a tensor's activation bytes equal elements times element size on every door
column3: bytes of one observed tensor value (an op output, or a buffer's final observed value); a total sums the retained ones; unit: bytes

column2: parameter bytes equal elements times element size over the unique parameters
column3: storage bytes of the parameters in scope, each parameter tensor counted once however many names hold it; unit: bytes

column2: the trace's tensor count equals the hand-counted op passes
column3: op passes in the trace, boundary ops (inputs, outputs, buffer reads and writes) included; unit: ops

column2: the compute-op count equals the hand-counted non-boundary op passes
column3: op passes that are not an input, output or buffer boundary; unit: ops

column2: the compute-layer count equals the hand-counted non-boundary layers
column3: layers (repeated passes of one operation grouped) that are not boundaries; unit: layers

column2: the layer-edge count equals the hand-counted rolled-graph edges
column3: distinct (parent layer, child layer) pairs, a pass feeding the next pass of its own layer included; unit: edges

column2: the input-op count equals the number of model input tensors
column3: input boundary op passes, one per model input tensor; unit: ops

column2: the input-layer count equals the number of model input tensors
column3: input boundary layers, one per model input tensor; unit: layers

column2: the output-op count equals the number of model output tensors
column3: output boundary op passes, one per model output tensor; unit: ops

column2: the output-layer count equals the number of model output tensors
column3: output boundary layers, one per model output tensor; unit: layers

column2: the buffer-read count equals the hand-counted registered-buffer reads
column3: buffer ops that bring a registered buffer's value into the graph; unit: ops

column2: the buffer-source count equals the hand-counted registered-buffer reads
column3: buffer ops that bring a buffer value in from outside the graph (the reads, which are parentless); unit: ops

column2: the buffer-write count equals the hand-counted recorded buffer writes
column3: buffer ops recording a write (in place, fused or reassigned) to a registered buffer; unit: ops

column2: the buffer-sink count equals the hand-counted recorded buffer writes
column3: buffer ops recording a write, the same set as the write ops whether or not a later op reads the written value; unit: ops

column2: the buffer-edge count equals the hand-counted edges touching a buffer op
column3: distinct op-graph edges with at least one buffer endpoint; unit: edges

column2: the internal-source count equals the hand-counted parentless non-input ops
column3: op passes with no parent that are not model inputs (factories and buffer reads); unit: ops

column2: the internal-source layer count equals the hand-counted parentless non-input layers
column3: layers of the internal-source ops; unit: layers

column2: the internal-sink count equals the hand-counted childless non-output ops
column3: op passes with no child that are not model outputs (discarded results and unread buffer writes); unit: ops

column2: the internal-sink layer count equals the hand-counted childless non-output layers
column3: layers of the internal-sink ops; unit: layers

column2: the parent count equals the hand-counted distinct producers
column3: distinct parent ops of an op, or distinct parent layers of a layer; unit: nodes

column2: the child count equals the hand-counted distinct consumers
column3: distinct child ops of an op, or distinct child layers of a layer; unit: nodes

column2: an op's input count equals its hand-counted graph parents
column3: distinct graph-parent ops feeding an op; unit: ops

column2: a module scope's internal edges equal the hand-counted edges inside it
column3: distinct op-graph edges whose both endpoints are ops of the module or call; unit: edges

column2: a module scope's input edges equal the hand-counted edges entering it
column3: distinct op-graph edges from an op outside the module or call to one inside; unit: edges

column2: a module scope's output edges equal the hand-counted edges leaving it
column3: distinct op-graph edges from an op inside the module or call to one outside; unit: edges

column2: the module-call count equals the hand-counted calls, the root call included
column3: module invocations in the trace, the root call counted once; unit: calls

column2: the uncalled-module count equals the hand-counted registered modules never called
column3: registered modules of the source model with no call in the trace; unit: modules

column2: the parameter-using op count equals the hand-counted op passes that read a parameter
column3: op passes that use at least one parameter tensor; unit: ops

column2: the parameter-using layer count equals the hand-counted layers that read a parameter
column3: layers with at least one op pass that uses a parameter tensor; unit: layers

column2: the saved-layer count equals the hand-counted layers with a retained activation
column3: layers with at least one op whose activation is retained; unit: layers

column2: the saved-call count equals the hand-counted calls with a retained output
column3: module calls, the root call included, with at least one output op whose activation is retained; unit: calls

column2: the saved-module count equals the hand-counted modules with a saved call
column3: modules with at least one saved module call; unit: modules

column2: the saved-gradient op count equals the hand-counted ops that received a gradient
column3: op passes whose output received and kept a gradient in backward; unit: ops

column2: the saved-gradient layer count equals the hand-counted layers that received a gradient
column3: layers with at least one op that kept a gradient; unit: layers

column2: the saved-gradient call count equals the hand-counted calls whose output received a gradient
column3: module calls, the root call included, with at least one output op that kept a gradient; unit: calls

column2: the saved-gradient module count equals the hand-counted modules with such a call
column3: modules with at least one saved-gradient module call; unit: modules

column2: the saved-gradient backward-node count equals the captured differentiable ops
column3: backward nodes (grad_fns) of captured forward ops that kept their gradients; unit: grad_fns

column2: the saved-gradient backward-call count equals saved nodes times backward passes
column3: calls of saved-gradient backward nodes, one per node per backward pass; unit: calls

column2: the frozen parameter-tensor count equals the hand count
column3: nn.Parameter tensors with requires_grad False consumed by an op/layer or owned by a module (the root owns all); unit: tensors

column2: the trainable parameter-tensor count equals the hand count
column3: nn.Parameter tensors with requires_grad True consumed by an op/layer or owned by a module (the root owns all); unit: tensors

column2: the nearest-input hop count equals the hand count
column3: fewest Op-graph edges from any model input; None when unreachable; unit: hops

column2: the farthest-input hop count equals the hand count
column3: most Op-graph edges from any model input; None when unreachable; unit: hops

column2: the nearest-output hop count equals the hand count
column3: fewest Op-graph edges to any model output; None when unreachable; unit: hops

column2: the farthest-output hop count equals the hand count
column3: most Op-graph edges to any model output; None when unreachable; unit: hops

column2: the largest Layer pass count equals the hand count
column3: most Ops (passes) grouped into one Layer; unit: ops

column2: a parameter's op-use count equals the hand count
column3: Ops that consumed the parameter tensor; unit: ops

column2: a parameter's layer-use count equals the hand count
column3: Layers whose Ops consumed the parameter tensor; unit: layers

column2: the positional-argument count equals the call as written
column3: positional arguments of the torch call; unit: arguments

column2: the keyword-argument count equals the call as written
column3: keyword arguments of the torch call; unit: arguments

column2: the argument total equals positional plus keyword
column3: all arguments of the torch call; unit: arguments

column2: gradient bytes equal element count times element size
column3: bytes of the gradient tensors an op, layer, parameter, buffer or trace holds, each tensor once at trace level; unit: bytes

column2: parameter-gradient bytes equal the raw Tensor.grad recount
column3: bytes of every parameter's .grad; unit: bytes

column2: saved gradient bytes equal the retained per-pass gradients
column3: bytes of the output gradients save_grads retained, one record per op per backward pass; unit: bytes

column2: a call's output-gradient bytes equal the hand count
column3: gradient bytes of the Ops forming a call's return value, summed over calls for a module; unit: bytes

column2: a call's internal-gradient bytes equal the hand count
column3: gradient bytes of a call's non-output Ops, summed over calls for a module; unit: bytes

column2: a call's output-activation bytes equal the hand count
column3: activation bytes of the Ops forming a call's return value, summed over calls for a module; unit: bytes

column2: a call's internal-activation bytes equal the hand count
column3: activation bytes of a call's non-output Ops, summed over calls for a module; unit: bytes

column2: subtree parameter bytes equal the hand count
column3: parameter bytes of every module under the address subtree, called or not; unit: bytes

column2: an op's input bytes equal its saved parents' bytes
column3: activation bytes of an Op's saved graph parents; unit: bytes

column2: the backward-node count equals a raw autograd-graph recount
column3: distinct autograd nodes reachable from the loss through next_functions; unit: nodes

column2: the backward-call count equals hook-counted node executions
column3: executions of backward nodes over all backward passes, counted by a hook per node; unit: calls

column2: the paired backward-node count equals the hand count
column3: backward nodes that are the grad_fn of an Op's own tensor; unit: nodes

column2: the unpaired backward-node count equals the recount minus the paired
column3: backward nodes not the grad_fn of any Op's own tensor; unit: nodes

column2: the backward-edge count equals a raw autograd-graph recount
column3: distinct (node, next node) pairs among reachable autograd nodes; unit: edges

column2: backward FLOPs equal the multiplier estimate where a backward node runs
column3: documented multiplier on forward FLOPs (linear 2x, elementwise 1x) for ops whose output has an autograd node, zero otherwise, summed over passes and calls; unit: FLOPs

column2: total FLOPs equal forward plus backward
column3: forward plus backward FLOPs, summed over passes and calls; unit: FLOPs

column2: arithmetic intensity equals FLOPs over read-once write-once bytes
column3: forward FLOPs / (input + parameter + output bytes); unit: FLOPs per byte

column2: the summary's unknown-compute count equals the hand count
column3: ops with no FLOP rule; unit: ops

column2: autograd-saved bytes equal a saved_tensors_hooks recount on every door
column3: bytes the captured forward's autograd saved for each op (a storage once per op, views in full), summed per Layer, call, module and trace; unit: bytes

column2: backward durations lie between a planted hook sleep and an outside clock
column3: seconds of all backward passes; unit: seconds

column2: the capture duration lies between a planted sleep and an outside clock
column3: seconds from capture start to end; unit: seconds

column2: the end thread count equals a recount, one higher after a planted thread
column3: live Python threads when the capture ended; unit: threads

column2: the start thread count equals threading.active_count()
column3: live Python threads when the capture started; unit: threads

column2: the cleanup duration is bounded by an outside clock
column3: seconds of postprocess after the forward; unit: seconds

column2: the accounted count equals the dispatch recount on a fully wrapped forward
column3: witness events attributed to a captured call; unit: events

column2: the witness callback time is bounded by an outside clock
column3: nanoseconds spent in witness callbacks; unit: nanoseconds

column2: the witness event count equals a TorchDispatchMode recount
column3: ATen dispatch events the completeness witness observed; unit: events

column2: the branch depth equals the hand-counted if nesting
column3: arms enclosing the op in the source (len of conditional_branch_stack); unit: levels

column2: the conditional depth equals the hand-counted direct roles
column3: distinct conditionals the record takes a direct role in (the consumed bool, or an arm-entry op); unit: conditionals

column2: the detector callback time is bounded by an outside clock
column3: nanoseconds spent in escape-detector callbacks; unit: nanoseconds

column2: the detector event count equals a TorchFunctionMode recount
column3: torch-function events the escape detector classified; unit: events

column2: forward durations lie between a planted sleep and an outside clock
column3: wall seconds of the forward (trace) or of the call's forward(); unit: seconds

column2: function-call totals exclude a planted non-op sleep and fit an outside clock
column3: seconds spent inside the ops' functions, summed over the scope; unit: seconds

column2: an op's function duration fits the forward minus a planted sleep
column3: seconds inside the op's function (0 for boundary nodes); unit: seconds

column2: the last backward duration lies between a planted hook sleep and an outside clock
column3: seconds of the most recent backward pass; unit: seconds

column2: the deepest nested-call depth equals the hand-counted call tree
column3: levels of nested ModuleCalls beneath the call (0 for a leaf); a Module takes the max over its calls; unit: levels

column2: an op's module-call depth equals the hand-counted non-root calls on the stack
column3: non-root ModuleCalls active when the op ran (the root call excluded); a Layer reads its first pass; unit: calls

column2: the autograd-saved tensor count equals a saved_tensors_hooks recount
column3: distinct tensors the captured forward's autograd saved for the op; unit: tensors

column2: the buffer-Layer count equals the hand-counted buffer Layers
column3: distinct buffer Layers, not their passes; unit: Layers

column2: a module's call count and a parameter's use count equal the hand counts
column3: Module: invocations of that module; Param: Ops that consumed the parameter (0 for a never-called module's); unit: calls

column2: the conditional count equals the hand-counted if statements
column3: tensor-bool conditionals the forward evaluated; unit: conditionals

column2: the nested-call count equals the hand-counted call tree
column3: ModuleCalls made while the call is on the stack, recursively; a Module sums over its calls; unit: calls

column2: the Layer count equals the hand-counted distinct Layers
column3: distinct Layers (a Layer run twice counts once) in the trace, the module or the call; unit: Layers

column2: the per-path parameter total equals named_parameters(remove_duplicate=False)
column3: parameter elements counted once per registration path, ties counted per path; unit: elements

column2: the address-recursive parameter-tensor count equals the hand count
column3: parameter tensors in the address subtree; unit: tensors

column2: the frozen address-recursive tensor count equals the hand count
column3: frozen parameter tensors in the address subtree; unit: tensors

column2: the trainable address-recursive tensor count equals the hand count
column3: trainable parameter tensors in the address subtree; unit: tensors

column2: the address-recursive parameter-record count equals the hand count
column3: nn.Parameter records owned by the module's address subtree, never-called descendants included; unit: records

column2: the frozen address-recursive record count equals the hand count
column3: frozen nn.Parameter records in the address subtree; unit: records

column2: the trainable address-recursive record count equals the hand count
column3: trainable nn.Parameter records in the address subtree; unit: records

column2: the overhead lies between a planted non-op sleep and an outside clock
column3: capture seconds outside function calls; unit: seconds

column2: pinned autograd bytes equal a whole-graph saved_tensors_hooks recount
column3: bytes of distinct non-Parameter tensors autograd saved upstream of the attached payloads; unit: bytes

column2: the setup duration is bounded by an outside clock
column3: seconds before the forward starts; unit: seconds

column2: the call's positional-argument count equals the hand count
column3: positional arguments the call's forward received, the root call included; unit: arguments

column2: the call's keyword-argument count equals the hand count
column3: keyword arguments the call's forward received, the root call included; unit: arguments

column2: the call's argument total equals the hand count
column3: positional plus keyword arguments of the call's forward, the root call included; unit: arguments

column2: the expected-opaque count equals the recounted tensor-to-Python reads
column3: witness events inside an audited opaque boundary (a tensor bool or scalar read); unit: events

column2: the at-capture payload bytes equal the saved activations' closed form
column3: bytes of every activation the capture saved, whether or not its payload is still here; unit: bytes

column2: the retained payload bytes equal the closed form, 0 on a payload-stripped artifact
column3: bytes of saved activations whose payload is resident or lazily loadable now; unit: bytes

column2: the advisory count equals the planted advisory kinds
column3: capture-advisory records on the trace, one per advisory kind the capture raised (each row aggregates its instances); unit: records

column2: the collapse priority equals the hand-counted hidden-op ratio
column3: a module's hidden ops (distinct subtree ops minus one) over the largest submodule's, rounded to 6 places; 0.0 for the root, a module of at most one Layer, or one whose single child hides the same ops; unit: ratio

column2: the forward peak is bounded by an outside resident-set measurement
column3: largest memory growth over the forward's starting baseline, including memory freed before the forward returns (CPU: resident high-water; CUDA: device allocator peak); None with a reason when a CPU forward measured zero; unit: bytes

column2: the backward peak is bounded by an outside resident-set measurement
column3: largest peak above a backward pass's starting baseline over all passes (CPU: resident high-water, largest pass; CUDA: growth of the device high-water mark); unit: bytes

column2: the retained gradient bytes equal the unique-storage closed form
column3: bytes of the gradient payloads the trace retains, once per storage (a view charges its whole base storage, an expanded view its smaller storage); unit: bytes
